description: This file implements an IPM (Inter-Processor Message) driver for Intel SEDI (Silicon Embedded Device Interface) in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, message sending, event handling, callback registration, and device configuration.

methods.name: set_ipm_dev_busy
methods.description: Sets the device busy status for IPM, locking IRQs during the operation.

methods.name: clear_ipm_dev_busy
methods.description: Clears the busy status for IPM and clears device busy if no longer busy.

methods.name: ipm_event_dispose
methods.description: Handles IPC events such as message input and peer acknowledgment.

methods.name: ipm_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPM device, sets up IPC, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: ipm_send_isr
methods.description: Handles message sending from ISR context.

methods.name: ipm_sedi_send
methods.description: Main function to send IPM messages, handling locking, busy status, and timeouts.

methods.name: ipm_sedi_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for received messages.

methods.name: ipm_sedi_get_max_data_size
methods.description: Returns maximum data size for IPM messages.

methods.name: ipm_sedi_get_max_id
methods.description: Returns maximum ID value for IPM messages.

methods.name: ipm_sedi_set_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the IPM device.
